units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 11:2">Sabb. XI, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 96a">96ᵃ</cite>) <he>בדייטי אחת</he> Y. ed. a. Ar. (Bab. <he>דיוטא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) in the same story (of separate buildings).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 63a:7">B. Bath. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>דיי׳ העליונה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דיו׳</he>) upper story.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6:2">Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לד׳ התחתונה וכ׳</he> to the nethermost room of the nether world (utmost degree of damnation; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="A01973"><he>אמבטה</he></cite>, <cite ref="A01974"><he>אַמְבְּטִי</he></cite>; <cite ref="B00505"><he>בְּטִי</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00583"><he>ביטי</he></cite>). Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 21 <he>דיוטא</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="D00451"><he>דיאטה</he></cite>, ed. <he>דיאטס</he>, corr. acc.); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 62">Gen. R. s. 62</cite> they buried him <he>בדיוטרין שלו</he> (corr. acc.) in the compartment designated for him.—Pl. <he>דְּיֵיטוֹת</he>, <he>דְּיוֹטוֹת</he>, <he>דְּיוֹטָאוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 8:11">Erub. VIII, 11</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 88a:19">88ᵃ</cite>) <he>שתי ד׳ וכ׳</he> two upper compartments opposite each other (with a common yard between them). Tosef. ib. VIII (V), 11, v. <cite ref="A01947"><he>אִלְקְטִי</he></cite>. Ib. XI (VIII), 4; a. fr.

senses.gloss: arbitrator’s office, whence diaeta, name of a prison in Cæsarea in the Roman days. Esth. R. introd., beg. (some ed. דְּיָטִי).
